baslik_yt: Does Coffee Dehydrate You? 50 Men, Two 3-Day Trials
aciklama: In a 2014 crossover trial, 50 men who regularly drank coffee spent three days on coffee and three on water. Their total body water was nearly identical. Here is what that means, and who the study left out. Note: the trial was funded by the Institute for Scientific Information on Coffee.
kaynaklar: Killer SC, Blannin AK, Jeukendrup AE. No evidence of dehydration with moderate daily coffee intake: a counterbalanced cross-over study in a free-living population. PLoS One. 2014;9(1):e84154. doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0084154. PMID 24416202.
Maughan RJ, Griffin J. Caffeine ingestion and fluid balance: a review. Journal of Human Nutrition and Dietetics. 2003;16(6):411-420. doi:10.1046/j.1365-277x.2003.00477.x. PMID 19774754.
U.S. Food and Drug Administration. Spilling the Beans: How Much Caffeine Is Too Much? Consumer Update, content current as of 28 August 2024. fda.gov.

sahneler.aksiyon: hot black coffee is poured from a copper pot into a porcelain cup beside a tall glass of water, thick steam swirling up, morning light, no person
sahneler.anlatim: Your daily coffee might hydrate you about as well as water.

sahneler.aksiyon: the Almanac reader lines up small coffee cups and water glasses on a long desk, pouring coffee into each cup, writing in a ledger with a quill, candle flames flickering
sahneler.anlatim: In 2014, 50 coffee drinkers spent three days on coffee and three on water.

sahneler.aksiyon: a large brass balance with a coffee pot on one pan and a water jug on the other, the pans swing up and down and slowly settle level, no person
sahneler.anlatim: Their body water barely moved: 51.5 kilograms on coffee, 51.4 on water.

sahneler.aksiyon: water drips steadily from a small copper tap into a basin beside a cup of coffee, coffee beans tumble out of a burlap sack, no person
sahneler.anlatim: Caffeine is a mild diuretic; big doses raise urine in people new to coffee.

sahneler.aksiyon: the Almanac reader sips coffee at his window as calendar pages flip past behind him and the morning light changes, he smiles, no other people anywhere
sahneler.anlatim: But regular drinkers adapt, and ordinary cups showed no real drying effect.

sahneler.aksiyon: a long coffee house counter with a row of steaming cups, one small tea cup slowly slides out of the row and spins gently, no person
sahneler.anlatim: The trial only tested men who already drank coffee, so others may respond differently.

sahneler.aksiyon: the Almanac reader fills a glass with water, then lifts a steaming cup of coffee and takes a sip, smiling by a sunny window, no other people anywhere
sahneler.anlatim: Your coffee counts as fluid; FDA calls 400 milligrams a day generally safe.
